<b>Pilgrim Grovellers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are pilgrims that have been taken by the [[Haunting]], capable of little more than prayer and aggression.<ref>Pilgrim Groveller [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Taken by Pharloom's Haunting, the bug is now capable of little more than prayer and aggression."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Grovellers are usually found slowly crawling around or praying in place, but some crawl out of the ground or are reanimated by [[Silk]] when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, ambushing her. When Hornet is near, they raise their arms briefly before leaping at her, continuing to crawl after landing.

There is a short period before Pilgrim Grovellers can attack again, providing a window to counterattack.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Grovellers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Pilgrim Grovellers can be found primarily in [[Mosshome]] and [[the Marrow]], but they also appear in the southeastern [[Far Fields]], the middle of [[Greymoor]], and the [[Blasted Steps]].

In the lower section of [[Mosshome]], two Pilgrim Grovellers change their locations slightly under certain conditions: the pilgrim near the statue of [[the Citadel]] symbol starts to crawl around the room once the passage below the statue has been opened, and another pilgrim on the upper floor descends from the platform to the table in its room once the [[Bell Beast]] has been defeated.

In [[Bonegrave]], one Pilgrim Groveller can appear as a possible enemy spawn variant upon revisiting the area. Inside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]], one is encountered as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Chapel_of_the_Wanderer|gauntlet]]. In the Marrow, once [[Swift Step]] has been acquired, one can be found in the room where [[Shakra]] was previously encountered, and two spawn during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Marrow 2|gauntlet]] in the north of the area.

During [[Act 3]], two Pilgrim Grovellers can be found in [[Shellwood]] attacking [[Pinmaster Plinney]].

== Trivia ==
* Pilgrim Grovellers share the same voice clips as [[Underscrub]]s.
* The body of the Pilgrim Groveller in a glass display within the exhbits section of the [[Memorium]] appears to have antennas, however loses them once the glass display is broken.
